name: evidence-backed-completion
description: Single-plugin marketplace, so this repository can be registered and installed directly with the Claude Code CLI, which resolves installs from marketplaces rather than from directory paths.

plugins.name: evidence-backed-completion
plugins.description: Coordinates formal, non-trivial work through a machine-readable task/evidence ledger: locked task contracts, independent author/reviewer tandems, SHA-256-bound evidence artifacts, and lead-validated completion so partial or self-attested work can't be reported as done.
